name: VRM_SOURCE_DOC_ADDL_SUBLINES
description: This table contains the fulfillment details of additional satisfaction events details of each promised detail.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ADDITIONAL_SLINE_ID
columns.description: Unique key generated by the application for an additional subline of a source document.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Unique key generated by the application for a source document line. Examples of source document lines include sales order lines, invoice lines, project lines, and service contract lines.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE_CODE

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE_ID

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_FROM_CODE
columns.description: The process or user interface from which this row is created.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.description: Oracle Internal use only.

columns.name: ASE_ENTERED_CUR_REVENUE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Fulfillment amount of the additional satisfaction event in the entered currency.

columns.name: ASE_CONT_CUR_ALLOC_REV_AMOUNT
columns.description: Allocated amount equivalent to the fulfillment amount of the additional satisfaction event in the contract currency.

columns.name: ASE_ELIGIBLE_DATE
columns.description: Eligible fulfillment date of the additional satisfaction event.

columns.name: ASE_PROCESS_ORDER
columns.description: Order in which the additional sublines are processed. These lines are processed in the ascending order of the fulfillment dates.

columns.name: ELIGIBLE_ASE_VALUE
columns.description: Value of the fulfillment of the additional satisfaction event according to the satisfaction measurement model. The value is either the satisfied quantity, satisfied percent, or period equivalent amount.
